music.type: Original procedurally synthesised 4/4 cinema-jazz lounge score
music.reference_title: The Best of Piero Piccioni - The Greatest Hits • Best Score Collection
music.reference_metadata: The linked page describes cinema and jazz. The public track list places Charms at 29:28 and the next track at 32:42, so 30:00 lies in Charms. Verified from visible YouTube page content on 7 November 2026.
music.verification_limit: The agent could inspect page metadata and track list but could not directly hear the reference audio. No claim of measured tempo, instrument transcription or note-level analysis is made.
music.uses: Broad genre and atmosphere brief. All harmony/melody/rhythm, voicing, tempo choices and synthesised instruments are original game design decisions. No third-party recording, samples or melody is used.
music.arrangement: 16-bar original melody with rests; seventh/ninth harmony; FM electric-piano-like keys, soft plucked voice, breathy lead, round bass, brushed noise percussion and generated room reflections.

scenes.cafe/prep: 80 BPM, softer keyboard lead and light brush
scenes.service: 96 BPM, firmer pulse and fewer melody notes
scenes.closing/receipt/review: 74 BPM, lower bell-like lead and sparse percussion
